summary: Websites and online applications are built and run using Joomla, a free and open-source content management system. This enables individuals and organizations to create and manage digital content, facilitating global communication and information sharing. Joomla's multilingual support and extensible API cater to diverse user needs, promoting digital inclusion and access to information. The system's robust access control and content workflows ensure secure and organized online presence. By empowering users to create and manage their own digital content, Joomla contributes to the development of digital skills and literacy.
